name: Shock Bubble
description: Each block sends a shock burst through the floor around you, hurting and briefly slowing enemies in the area.
details: When you block, lightning crackles across the floor in a circle around you (about 3.6 m, bigger with Block size). Every enemy in it takes the Shock burst damage once and is slowed for a moment. Your bubble is also a bit bigger. It no longer zaps on touch.
